units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|name|161|0
units.english: Visit stellar garden
units.italian: Visita il giardino stellare

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|description|162|0
units.english: Attempt to land on the stellar metal garden orbiting the Kasii-Cavaasa star.
units.italian: Tenta di atterrare sul giardino di metallo stellare in orbita attorno alla stella Kasii-Cavaasa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|You meet Tiliia at their workshop, where they wave you inside. The scanner on their table has now been replaced by a collection of quantum keystones suspended in a variety of machines that prod and scan the stones incessantly. "Good news for thee, Captain, for all of us," Tiliia says. "The data from our expedition hath revealed some measure of the mystery of thy stones. They're oscillators of a sort, ones that sing in tune with the wavers of the wormhole..." Tiliia stops for a moment. "But we will have time to discuss that later. For now, what thou needest know is this: with the right materials, we may be able to magnify their effect. Hast thou visited the system Kasii-Cavaasa before, within the Tangles?"|172|0
units.english: You meet Tiliia at their workshop, where they wave you inside. The scanner on their table has now been replaced by a collection of quantum keystones suspended in a variety of machines that prod and scan the stones incessantly. "Good news for thee, Captain, for all of us," Tiliia says. "The data from our expedition hath revealed some measure of the mystery of thy stones. They're oscillators of a sort, ones that sing in tune with the wavers of the wormhole..." Tiliia stops for a moment. "But we will have time to discuss that later. For now, what thou needest know is this: with the right materials, we may be able to magnify their effect. Hast thou visited the system Kasii-Cavaasa before, within the Tangles?"
units.italian: Incontri Tiliia nella loro officina, dove ti fanno cenno di entrare. Lo scanner sul tavolo è stato sostituito da una collezione di pietre chiave quantistiche sospese in macchine varie che pungolano e scansionano le pietre senza posa. "Buone notizie per te, capitano, e per tutti noi," dice Tiliia. "I dati della nostra spedizione hanno rivelato un po' del mistero delle tue pietre. Sono una specie di oscillatori, che cantano all'unisono con le increspature del wormhole..." Tiliia si ferma un momento. "Ma avremo tempo di parlarne dopo. Per ora, quello che ti serve sapere è questo: con i materiali giusti, potremmo riuscire ad amplificarne l'effetto. Sei mai stato nel sistema Kasii-Cavaasa, dentro i Tangles?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	"I have."|174|0
units.english: "I have."
units.italian: "Ci sono stato."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	"Where are you going with this?"|175|0
units.english: "Where are you going with this?"
units.italian: "Dove vuoi arrivare?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	Tiliia continues. "The star of that system is borne upon by a number of stellar metal gardens, vast stations to grow in the star's harsh radiation the rare metals necessary to our works. Their bounty is the key to our success. Forty tons or so would be enough to subdivide those keystones to supply all of the New Houses. We could render our wormhole-crossing armor obsolete - improve our probes, perform more archaeology." They pause, and a wave of color bounds down their limbs. "It could even help solve this present mystery of ours. So what thinks thou?"|176|0
units.english: Tiliia continues. "The star of that system is borne upon by a number of stellar metal gardens, vast stations to grow in the star's harsh radiation the rare metals necessary to our works. Their bounty is the key to our success. Forty tons or so would be enough to subdivide those keystones to supply all of the New Houses. We could render our wormhole-crossing armor obsolete - improve our probes, perform more archaeology." They pause, and a wave of color bounds down their limbs. "It could even help solve this present mystery of ours. So what thinks thou?"
units.italian: Tiliia continua. "La stella di quel sistema è circondata da diversi giardini di metallo stellare, enormi stazioni dove, nella radiazione aspra della stella, si coltivano i metalli rari necessari ai nostri lavori. Il loro raccolto è la chiave del nostro successo. Una quarantina di tonnellate basterebbero a suddividere quelle pietre per rifornire tutte le Nuove Casate. Potremmo rendere obsoleta la nostra corazza per attraversare i wormhole: migliorare le sonde, fare più archeologia." Si fermano, e un'onda di colore scende lungo le loro membra. "Potrebbe perfino aiutare a risolvere questo nostro mistero attuale. Allora, che ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	"You want me to fly into a star? Are you crazy?"|178|0
units.english: "You want me to fly into a star? Are you crazy?"
units.italian: "Vuoi che voli dentro una stella? Sei pazzo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	"And how do you plan for us to get close enough to collect that?"|180|0
units.english: "And how do you plan for us to get close enough to collect that?"
units.italian: "E come pensi che riusciremo ad avvicinarci tanto da raccoglierlo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	"The shields of thy craft may be sufficient to the task," Tiliia says, purple dotting their face. "And if not, we will have warning before they fail. We shall have to act with care and see for ourselves what is possible."|181|0
units.english: "The shields of thy craft may be sufficient to the task," Tiliia says, purple dotting their face. "And if not, we will have warning before they fail. We shall have to act with care and see for ourselves what is possible."
units.italian: "Gli scudi della tua nave potrebbero bastare," dice Tiliia, con macchie viola sul volto. "E se no, avremo un avviso prima che cedano. Dovremo agire con cautela e vedere di persona che cosa è possibile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	Purple dots spot Tiliia's face. "Not 'into,' not strictly. But yes, I do not know if thy craft is worthy to the task. We shall have to see for ourselves what is possible."|185|0
units.english: Purple dots spot Tiliia's face. "Not 'into,' not strictly. But yes, I do not know if thy craft is worthy to the task. We shall have to see for ourselves what is possible."
units.italian: Macchie viola punteggiano il volto di Tiliia. "Non 'dentro', non alla lettera. Ma sì, non so se la tua nave sia all'altezza dell'impresa. Dovremo vedere di persona che cosa è possibile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|Your ship protests even as you near Kasii-Cavaasa, alarms ringing incessantly and heat meters spiking. The stellar metal garden is still little more than a dot against the roiling mass of the star. As you descend upon it, the cockpit grows uncomfortably hot and is thick with the scent of ozone; Tiliia looks even more miserable than you in the heat. Suddenly, something happens with the shields, and the intense heat of the star begins scouring bits of the <ship>'s hull. Tiliia finally speaks: "Enough, captain. We shall have to regroup and find a different strategy."|192|0
units.english: Your ship protests even as you near Kasii-Cavaasa, alarms ringing incessantly and heat meters spiking. The stellar metal garden is still little more than a dot against the roiling mass of the star. As you descend upon it, the cockpit grows uncomfortably hot and is thick with the scent of ozone; Tiliia looks even more miserable than you in the heat. Suddenly, something happens with the shields, and the intense heat of the star begins scouring bits of the <ship>'s hull. Tiliia finally speaks: "Enough, captain. We shall have to regroup and find a different strategy."
units.italian: La tua nave protesta già mentre ti avvicini a Kasii-Cavaasa, con gli allarmi che suonano senza sosta e i termometri che schizzano. Il giardino di metallo stellare è ancora poco più di un punto contro la massa ribollente della stella. Mentre scendi verso di esso, l'abitacolo diventa caldo in modo sgradevole e si riempie di un forte odore di ozono; Tiliia sembra stare anche peggio di te, con quel caldo. All'improvviso, qualcosa succede agli scudi, e il calore intenso della stella comincia a raschiare via pezzi dello scafo della <ship>. Alla fine Tiliia parla: "Basta, capitano. Dovremo riorganizzarci e trovare una strategia diversa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	(Retreat.)|194|0
units.english: (Retreat.)
units.italian: (Ritirata.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	(Press on.)|195|0
units.english: (Press on.)
units.italian: (Insisti.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	You order the <ship> upward from the star, and the alarms eventually quiet. "Take us back to <origin>," says Tiliia, looking a little dejected. "We must decide what is to be done there."|198|0
units.english: You order the <ship> upward from the star, and the alarms eventually quiet. "Take us back to <origin>," says Tiliia, looking a little dejected. "We must decide what is to be done there."
units.italian: Ordini alla <ship> di risalire dalla stella, e alla fine gli allarmi tacciono. "Riportaci a <origin>," dice Tiliia, con l'aria un po' abbattuta. "Dobbiamo decidere lì che cosa fare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	"Art thou mad?" shouts Tiliia, terror evident on their skin. "We must retreat!"|202|0
units.english: "Art thou mad?" shouts Tiliia, terror evident on their skin. "We must retreat!"
units.italian: "Sei impazzito?" grida Tiliia, con il terrore evidente sulla pelle. "Dobbiamo ritirarci!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	(Retreat.)|204|0
units.english: (Retreat.)
units.italian: (Ritirata.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	(Keep going.)|206|0
units.english: (Keep going.)
units.italian: (Continua.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	The <ship> braves the heat a minute or so longer, despite Tiliia's protests. The shields don't give out completely until a solar flare suddenly engulfs the ship, instantly vaporizing it, you, and Tiliia and scattering your atoms among the cold and indifferent stars.|207|0
units.english: The <ship> braves the heat a minute or so longer, despite Tiliia's protests. The shields don't give out completely until a solar flare suddenly engulfs the ship, instantly vaporizing it, you, and Tiliia and scattering your atoms among the cold and indifferent stars.
units.italian: La <ship> sfida il calore per un altro minuto circa, nonostante le proteste di Tiliia. Gli scudi non cedono del tutto finché un'eruzione solare non inghiotte all'improvviso la nave, vaporizzando in un istante te, Tiliia e la nave stessa, e disperdendo i vostri atomi fra le stelle fredde e indifferenti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|label|210|0
units.english: no shields
units.italian: no shields

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	Even approaching the Kasii-Cavaasa star is enough to bring the inside of the <ship> to an uncomfortably sweltering temperature. Without shielding of any sort, its hull rapidly approaches the point of thermal failure and, at Tiliia's insistence, you are forced to return to a higher orbit.|211|0
units.english: Even approaching the Kasii-Cavaasa star is enough to bring the inside of the <ship> to an uncomfortably sweltering temperature. Without shielding of any sort, its hull rapidly approaches the point of thermal failure and, at Tiliia's insistence, you are forced to return to a higher orbit.
units.italian: Anche solo avvicinarsi alla stella Kasii-Cavaasa basta a portare l'interno della <ship> a una temperatura soffocante e sgradevole. Senza alcun tipo di scudo, lo scafo si avvicina rapidamente al cedimento termico e, per insistenza di Tiliia, sei costretto a risalire su un'orbita più alta.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|log|214|0
units.english: Attempted to retrieve stellar metal from Predecessor space for House Aqrabe, but was driven back by the intense heat.
units.italian: Hai tentato di recuperare metallo stellare dallo spazio dei Predecessori per Casa Aqrabe, ma il calore intenso ti ha respinto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|Tiliia spent most of the journey holed away, poring over data gathered from your star-diving expedition, but it didn't take long after the <ship>'s landing gear touch the ground of the <planet> spaceport that they are out and about, stretching their arms in the air. They remain nearby until you've finished post-flight checks and thank you for transporting them, now surrounded by several scholarly-dressed Successors. Before they head off, they ask you to return to the spaceport by sundown.|216|0
units.english: Tiliia spent most of the journey holed away, poring over data gathered from your star-diving expedition, but it didn't take long after the <ship>'s landing gear touch the ground of the <planet> spaceport that they are out and about, stretching their arms in the air. They remain nearby until you've finished post-flight checks and thank you for transporting them, now surrounded by several scholarly-dressed Successors. Before they head off, they ask you to return to the spaceport by sundown.
units.italian: Tiliia ha passato gran parte del viaggio rintanata, immersa nei dati raccolti dalla vostra spedizione nella stella, ma non passa molto tempo da quando il carrello della <ship> tocca il suolo dello spazioporto della <planet> che sono già fuori, a sgranchirsi le braccia all'aria aperta. Restano lì vicino finché non hai finito i controlli post-volo e ti ringraziano per il trasporto, ora circondati da diversi Successori in abiti da studiosi. Prima di andarsene, ti chiedono di tornare allo spazioporto al tramonto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 3|	Shortly before you depart into the port yourself, you overhear some of the ground crew remarking on the <ship>'s scorched hull.|217|0
units.english: Shortly before you depart into the port yourself, you overhear some of the ground crew remarking on the <ship>'s scorched hull.
units.italian: Poco prima che ti addentri anche tu nel porto, senti per caso alcuni del personale di terra che commentano lo scafo bruciacchiato della <ship>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|name|220|0
units.english: Pick up ship from Kaatrij
units.italian: Ritira la nave da Kaatrij

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|description|221|0
units.english: Pick up a modified Vujlet from House Kaatrij at <destination>.
units.italian: Ritira un Vujlet modificato da Casa Kaatrij su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|Tiliia stands waiting for you in the same statue garden where they met you earlier, though this time they are alone, tapping at a metallic pad under an overhanging light. They offer a curt greeting of colors when they see you. "I've news both foul and fair for thee," they say. "Thy craft shall not suit for our task. Perhaps with a year of study it could be adapted to our aims, but Aqrabe and I agree that would not do."|229|0
units.english: Tiliia stands waiting for you in the same statue garden where they met you earlier, though this time they are alone, tapping at a metallic pad under an overhanging light. They offer a curt greeting of colors when they see you. "I've news both foul and fair for thee," they say. "Thy craft shall not suit for our task. Perhaps with a year of study it could be adapted to our aims, but Aqrabe and I agree that would not do."
units.italian: Tiliia ti aspetta nello stesso giardino di statue dove ti hanno incontrato prima, anche se questa volta sono da soli, e tamburellano su una tavoletta metallica sotto una luce pensile. Ti salutano con un cenno di colori secco quando ti vedono. "Ho notizie, una cattiva e una buona," dicono. "La tua nave non è adatta al nostro compito. Forse con un anno di studio potrebbe essere adattata ai nostri scopi, ma Aqrabe ed io conveniamo che non andrebbe bene."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	"So what is the good news?"|231|0
units.english: "So what is the good news?"
units.italian: "E allora qual è la buona notizia?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	"So is that it for this?"|232|0
units.english: "So is that it for this?"
units.italian: "Quindi finisce qui?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	"Fortunately," they continue, "we may be able to outfit one of our own craft for this purpose. Or rather, one of House Kaatrij's."|233|0
units.english: "Fortunately," they continue, "we may be able to outfit one of our own craft for this purpose. Or rather, one of House Kaatrij's."
units.italian: "Per fortuna," continuano, "potremmo allestire una delle nostre navi per questo scopo. O meglio, una di Casa Kaatrij."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	They offer the pad to you. It displays a schematic that you struggle to make any sense of; some small device is shown implanted in a Vujlet, its long tendrils snaking into various ship systems like some sort of infection. If you were to make a guess at its function, you might describe it as some sort of cloaking device - it's clearly shown reflecting and refracting light somehow, but the details of what exactly it is achieving escape your reckoning.|234|0
units.english: They offer the pad to you. It displays a schematic that you struggle to make any sense of; some small device is shown implanted in a Vujlet, its long tendrils snaking into various ship systems like some sort of infection. If you were to make a guess at its function, you might describe it as some sort of cloaking device - it's clearly shown reflecting and refracting light somehow, but the details of what exactly it is achieving escape your reckoning.
units.italian: Ti porgono la tavoletta. Mostra uno schema di cui fatichi a capire qualcosa; un piccolo congegno appare impiantato in un Vujlet, con i suoi lunghi viticci che serpeggiano nei vari sistemi della nave come una specie di infezione. Se dovessi azzardare una ipotesi sulla sua funzione, potresti descriverlo come una sorta di dispositivo di occultamento: è chiaramente raffigurato mentre riflette e rifrange la luce in qualche modo, ma i dettagli di che cosa esattamente ottenga sfuggono al tuo giudizio.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	"I've conferred with our fleet liaison," says Tiliia, "who conferred with Kaatrij's, and they've agreed to bestow upon thee a modified Vujlet." They pause before adding, in a softer and more cynical tone, "no doubt extracting some favor from Aqrabe along the way. We need thee to retrieve it from <planet> and bring it back here for outfitting. Once prepared with our armor and thy jump drive, we may return to Kasii-Cavaasa."|235|0
units.english: "I've conferred with our fleet liaison," says Tiliia, "who conferred with Kaatrij's, and they've agreed to bestow upon thee a modified Vujlet." They pause before adding, in a softer and more cynical tone, "no doubt extracting some favor from Aqrabe along the way. We need thee to retrieve it from <planet> and bring it back here for outfitting. Once prepared with our armor and thy jump drive, we may return to Kasii-Cavaasa."
units.italian: "Ho parlato con il nostro ufficiale di collegamento con la flotta," dice Tiliia, "che ha parlato con quello di Kaatrij, e hanno accettato di concederti un Vujlet modificato." Si fermano prima di aggiungere, in tono più sommesso e più cinico, "estraendo senza dubbio qualche favore da Aqrabe per la strada. Dobbiamo chiederti di ritirarlo su <planet> e di riportarlo qui per l'allestimento. Una volta pronto con la nostra corazza e il tuo motore di salto, potremo tornare a Kasii-Cavaasa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	"These look like some complex modifications."|237|0
units.english: "These look like some complex modifications."
units.italian: "Sembrano modifiche piuttosto complesse."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	"Last I checked, I wasn't on the best terms with Kaatrij."|239|0
units.english: "Last I checked, I wasn't on the best terms with Kaatrij."
units.italian: "L'ultima volta che ho controllato, non ero in ottimi rapporti con Kaatrij."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	"Let's go, then."|243|0
units.english: "Let's go, then."
units.italian: "Andiamo, allora."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	A gentle ripple of orange passes over Tiliia. "They are, Captain. I am told Kaatrij keep some Vujleten for research - no, 'tis not for me to say."|248|0
units.english: A gentle ripple of orange passes over Tiliia. "They are, Captain. I am told Kaatrij keep some Vujleten for research - no, 'tis not for me to say."
units.italian: Una lieve increspatura arancione passa su Tiliia. "Lo sono, capitano. Mi dicono che Kaatrij tenga alcuni Vujlet per la ricerca... no, non sta a me dirlo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	Though you try to push them further, Tiliia offers no more information on Kaatrij's modifications.|249|0
units.english: Though you try to push them further, Tiliia offers no more information on Kaatrij's modifications.
units.italian: Anche se cerchi di insistere, Tiliia non offre altre informazioni sulle modifiche di Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	Tiliia burbles in a gentle display of laughter, pink spots breaking out on the tips of their arms. "Who is?" they say. "Now most of all."|252|0
units.english: Tiliia burbles in a gentle display of laughter, pink spots breaking out on the tips of their arms. "Who is?" they say. "Now most of all."
units.italian: Tiliia gargarizza in una lieve esibizione di risate, con macchie rosa che affiorano sulle punte delle braccia. "Chi lo è?" dicono. "Ora più che mai."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 4|	"Oh," Tiliia says just before you leave, "and also, Kaatrij wishes to send along an observer. Perhaps they have cause to be suspicious. Ugh, perhaps they're just suspicious by nature."|255|0
units.english: "Oh," Tiliia says just before you leave, "and also, Kaatrij wishes to send along an observer. Perhaps they have cause to be suspicious. Ugh, perhaps they're just suspicious by nature."
units.italian: "Oh," dice Tiliia poco prima che tu parta, "e inoltre Kaatrij vuole mandare con te un osservatore. Forse hanno motivo di essere sospettosi. Ugh, forse sono sospettosi per natura."
